claims.text: Bob Dylan won the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature.
Leonard Cohen, Paul Simon and Joni Mitchell did not win the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature.
The Nobel citation for Bob Dylan reads 'for having created new poetic expressions within the great American song tradition'.
Dylan did not attend the December 2016 award ceremony and delivered his Nobel lecture as a recording in June 2017.
